pages: Google Nest Thermostat SUBMITTAL SHEET Job Name Engineer Google Rep. Models GA02180-US (Snow, Pro) QTY GA02081-US (Charcoal) QTY GA02083-US (Fog) QTY GA02082-US (Sand) QTY APPLICATION All Models: It works with conventional systems that have one stage of heating and cooling and a second stage of either heating or cooling. It works with heat pumps that have one stage of heating and cooling and either aux or emergency heat. The Nest Thermostat */OB (star/OB) connector can accept one of these wires: O/B, W2, Y2. SPECIFICATIONS Terminal Application Y1 Stage 1 Compressor W1 Stage 1 Heat, Aux Heat, Alt Heat G Fan C Common */OB Heat Pump Reversing Valve, Stage 2 Cooling, Stage 2 Heating R 24v Power Display: 2.4-inch QVGA IPS liquid crystal display (240 x 320 pixels) with digital brightness enhancement film and mirrored glass lens. Indicators: Thermostat display indicates via text and color when heating/cooling or another accessory or function is running such as emergency heat. Acceptable Storage Conditions: ● -4 °F to 113 °F ● Up to 95% humidity ● Up to 15,000 ft. altitude Temperature Ranges: Max cooling 90 °F, min heating 50 °F. PRODUCT FEATURES Pro Setup: Pro Setup on Google Home app does not require Wi-Fi or customer device. Automated Pro ID, Pro contact information on device and in Google Home app, power test. Smart Monitoring: HVAC System Health Monitor alerts customers to potential issues related to their HVAC equipment. Scheduling: 7-day programmable, Savings Finder, fan schedule, geofencing, built in motion sensor. Increased Equipment Compatibility: Pro settings, emergency heat is supported without dedicated wire. Intelligent Features: Home/Away Routines, Eco Temps, Savings Finder, Seasonal Savings, Heat Pump Balance, Cool to Dry, demand response eligible via Nest Renew. Accessories: Trim plate (not included), electrical box adapter (not included), Nest Power Connector (not included). Wi-Fi Communication: Provides remote access through smartphone or tablet when connected to Wi-Fi and registered to the Google Home app. Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n, 2.4 GHz and 5GHz secure: AES-128, SSL/TLS, WEP, WPA/WPA2. Power: 2 AAA 1.5V alkaline batteries. Uses less than 1 kWh/month. ● Voltage 20-30VAC ● Startup/Max current 4VA ● Standby current 2VA Power Sharing: The Nest Thermostat has a power test that will let you know if more power is needed. If so, you can install a C wire or Nest Power Connector to ensure that the thermostat always has enough power. Built in Sensors: ● Temperature ● Humidity ● Soli sensor (motion sense) ● Ambient light ● Capacitive touch ● Nest utilizes local weather data over Wi-Fi instead of outdoor temperature sensors Certifications: ● ENERGY STAR® Certified ● US FCC Compliance ● Canada ISED RF Compliance ● UL Marking ● California CEC Backup Battery Charger System Efficiency ● California CEC Title 24 JA5 Criteria for Occupant Controlled Smart Thermostats Google and Nest Thermostat are trademarks of Google LLC.
